description:
Title: Find a Job

You have to regularly report, to which companies you wrote job applications.
Based on your job applications, new potential job offers are sent to you.
Companies have to confirm that they received job applications and rate the application.
A job interview can be negotiated.
When a company wants you to work for them, you enter the probation phase.
After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.
Reviews for a company can only be seen (by job applicants) after 1 year.
If a job becomes permanent, the process ends, unless you rated the company C or less, then you continue to receive job offers, but no longer have to report.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicationResponse" name="Application receipt confirmation and rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PotentialOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyWantsApplicant" name="Company wants applicant to work for them"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyRatesApplicant" name="Company rating of applicant"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FindAJob" name="Find a Job" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_FindAJob" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Regularly report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ApplicationResponse" name="Receive application confirmation and rating">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ApplicationResponse" messageRef="Message_ApplicationResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PotentialOffer" name="Receive potential job offer">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PotentialOffer" messageRef="Message_PotentialOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewDecision" name="Negotiate a job interview?" default="Flow_NoInterview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate a job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview decision"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyWantsApplicant" name="Company wants applicant to work for them">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CompanyWantsApplicant" messageRef="Message_CompanyWantsApplicant"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Probation" name="Undergo probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate the company"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PostProbationSplit" name="Continue after probation"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRatingSplit" name="Company rates applicant?" default="Flow_CompanyRatingSkipped"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyRatesApplicant" name="Receive company rating">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CompanyRatesApplicant" messageRef="Message_CompanyRatesApplicant"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRatingJoin" name="Continue after company rating"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CompanyRatingBranch" name="Company rating received or skipped"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitOneYear" name="Wait one year for company review visibility">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeReviewVisible" name="Make company review visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReviewVisible" name="Company review visible to job applicants"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PermanentDecision" name="Does the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RatingThreshold" name="Rated company C or less?" default="Flow_RatingAboveC"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Process" name="Job becomes permanent; process ends"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ContinueOffers" name="Continue receiving job offers without reporting"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Report" sourceRef="StartEvent_FindAJob" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Report_Response" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Event_ApplicationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Response_Offer" sourceRef="Event_ApplicationResponse" targetRef="Event_PotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offer_InterviewDecision" sourceRef="Event_PotentialOffer" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewYes" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interview is negotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInterview" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewDone" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewMerge_Wants" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Event_CompanyWantsApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wants_Probation" sourceRef="Event_CompanyWantsApplicant" targetRef="Task_Probation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Probation_RateCompany" sourceRef="Task_Probation" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateCompany_PostProbationSplit" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_PostProbationSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostProbation_CompanyRating" sourceRef="Gateway_PostProbationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyRates" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingSplit" targetRef="Event_CompanyRatesApplicant">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">company rates applicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyRatingSkipped" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingSplit" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyRatingReceived" sourceRef="Event_CompanyRatesApplicant" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyRatingJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_CompanyRatingBranch"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostProbation_ReviewTimer" sourceRef="Gateway_PostProbationSplit" targetRef="Event_WaitOneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitYear_ReviewVisible" sourceRef="Event_WaitOneYear" targetRef="Task_MakeReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewVisible_End" sourceRef="Task_MakeReviewVisible" targetRef="EndEvent_ReviewVisible"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostProbation_PermanentDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_PostProbationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_PermanentDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobNotPermanent" sourceRef="Gateway_PermanentDecision" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">job does not become permanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobPermanent" sourceRef="Gateway_PermanentDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">job becomes permanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingCOrLower" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold" targetRef="EndEvent_ContinueOffers">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">applicant rated company C or lower</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingAboveC" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold" targetRef="EndEvent_Process"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_FindAJob"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApplicationResponse" name="Application receipt confirmation and rating" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Event_ApplicationResponse" messageRef="Message_ApplicationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PotentialOffer" name="Potential job offer" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Event_PotentialOffer" messageRef="Message_PotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyWantsApplicant" name="Company wants applicant to work for them" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Event_CompanyWantsApplicant" messageRef="Message_CompanyWantsApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyRatesApplicant" name="Company rating of applicant" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Event_CompanyRatesApplicant" messageRef="Message_CompanyRatesApplicant"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
